---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem with FindBack
---

Describe the problem and the behavior you expected.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest reproducible steps, preferably using the controlled sample or synthetic inputs.

## Environment

Include the FindBack revision, operating system, Python and Node.js versions, and perception backend. Mention GPU/model versions only if relevant.

## Validation

Include relevant test results or sanitized error messages. Remove tokens, private endpoints, personal paths and private footage. Report vulnerabilities through [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/devin-lai/agentx-findback/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
